    • afterGet

      public static Object afterGet(ProxyMap map, Object key, Object ret, boolean before)
      Call after invoking Map.get(Object) on super. The potential change is tracked when the get method is called. This change will not translated to an update statement if the retrieved value is not dirty.
      Parameters:
      ret - the return value from the super's method
      before - the return value from beforeGet(ProxyMap, Object)
      Returns:
      the value to return from Map.get(Object)
